description: Leapfrog Geo is implicit 3D geological modelling software that builds updatable models of lithology, structure and grade from drillhole data, structural measurements, points, polylines and meshes, for geological interpretation and resource estimation. It is produced by Seequent, the Bentley Subsurface Company within Bentley Systems. It is used worldwide in mining, its main market, and in oil and gas, geothermal, carbon storage, civil engineering and tunnelling, and groundwater and contamination studies. Extensions add resource estimation and block modelling (Edge), seismic and GPR data (Geophysics) and links to MODFLOW and FEFLOW (Hydrogeology); models are shared through the Seequent Central cloud service and it works with ArcGIS Pro. Licences are commercial subscriptions, 12-month named or shared seats bought online, with enterprise licences on request, so cost is paid. Caveat: models are only as good as the drillhole data and the geologist's interpretation, and implicit surfaces can look smoother than the geology. For simulation it supplies the subsurface geometry for mine planning, slope and tunnel hazard studies and groundwater models that feed infrastructure risk analyses. It is related to the GemPy and OpenGeoSys records in this catalogue, which offer open-source geological modelling and coupled process simulation.
